changelog: 🩹 Fixed black screen crash at the end of multi-episode binge playback (countdown card bug)
🛡️ New renderer-crash guard: if the video engine dies the app now recovers itself instead of staying black
🚪 Back button escape hatch: 3 quick Back presses always return you to the Home screen, even if the app is stuck
🚀 Memory optimization: OS low-memory cache pruning for uninterrupted long streaming sessions
🎬 AJO TV 4.0 — completely rebuilt as a native app: faster menus, smooth 4K playback, better remote handling
📺 2000+ live channels now built in (AJO Live source auto-installs on first launch) — Indian, news, sports, movies, kids, music
🗂️ Browse live channels by category: News, Movies, Entertainment, Sports, Kids and more
🔊 Subtitles, audio track selection and resume-where-you-left-off
⬆️ Faster in-app updates delivered straight from GitHub
